messages:
ada: heads up — after the compact-scheduler v2 rollout (~10:12 UTC) we're seeing ~120 GPU pods Pending in us-west1-b, but nodes show available GPU capacity. looks like packing is scattering tiny-gangs across different GPU types and triggering nic egress saturation.

mike: can you paste the pending pod list + node assignment?

ada: sure, pasted snippet:```
$ kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep Pending | head
gpu-train-xyz-0   Pending   0/1 nodes are available: 1 node(s) had insufficient nvidia.com/gpu.
llm-worker-a01    Pending   0/1 nodes are available: 2 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate.
small-gang-b      Pending   0/1 nodes are available: 3 node(s) had incompatible GPU flavor.
```

julia: that message set is weird — nodes show GPUs free? can you `kubectl describe node` one of the candidate nodes?

ada: `kubectl describe node usw1-node-23` excerpt:```
Taints: gpu-shape=4xA100:NoSchedule
Capacity: nvidia.com/gpu=4
Allocatable: nvidia.com/gpu=4
Allocated resources: nvidia.com/gpu: 0
Conditions: Ready
```

mike: aha — scheduler is respecting the new `gpu-shape` label affinity in a strict way, compact-scheduler v2 changed the coalescing rule to avoid mixing shapes. tiny-gang pods don't set `gpu-preferred-shape`, so they're being rejected as "incompatible flavor". new behavior was supposed to reduce NVLINK misplacement but it's starving tiny jobs.

sre-ops: metric check: network egress for that rack spiked at rollout time (https://metrics/redwood/usw1/egress). pods are being spread across racks -> extra egress due to dataset staging.

nora: we have 3 mitigations: 1) hotfix scheduler to fall back to tolerant matching for pods < 2 GPUs; 2) add a default toleration/annotation for tiny-gang to accept mixed shapes; 3) rollback rollout (deploy-bot can do canary revert). Which do we want now?

ada: I prefer hotfix 1 to avoid rollback churn. small jobs are latency-sensitive and cost-insensitive.

mike: agree. hotfix plan: change coalescer threshold from 1.0 -> 0.6 for pods with resource.gpus <=2, and publish a patch. sample config diff:```yaml
coalescer:
  strict_shape_threshold: 1.0  # old
  shape_relax_for_small: 0.6   # new override for <=2 GPUs
```

julia: ok add unit test and a canary in us-west1-c first. can ops schedule a short maintenance window to patch?

sre-ops: we can patch in 10m. rolling restart of scheduler pods, no node drain. brief metric watch. I'll create an alert suppression for the next 30m.

deploy-bot: rollout compact-scheduler v2 patch started by nora at 1775012450. progress: 1/3 scheduler pods updated.

ada: after patch applied in canary, Pending count fell from 120 -> 8 in 3m. NIC egress dropped ~40%.

mike: nice. we should still follow up: 1) update pod creation templates to include `gpu-preferred-shape` for training jobs, 2) document fallback behavior in scheduler docs, 3) run a simulation to measure NVLINK regression if we relax shapes for tiny jobs.

nora: created ticket INF-4287 for docs + tests + sim. assigning to platform-team.

julia: FYI cost note — the current scatter causes a ~12% egress cost bump in us-west1 for last 12h; include cost impact in the ticket.

ada: thanks everyone. I'll keep monitoring and will post a short postmortem if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
